spans.s:
(टु) टुरु r. 2nd cl. (रौति)
To sound, to make a particular sort of sound.
(ड,) रुङ् r. 1st cl. (रवते)
1 To go, to move.
2 To hurt, to injure or kill.
3 To speak.
4 To be angry.

m. (रुः)
1 War, battle.
2 Noise, sound.
f. (रुः)
1 Fear, alarm.
2 Cutting, dividing.
E.
रु to sound, aff. क्विप्.
